case: If you believe a WR3 who keeps drawing more targets matters more than an RB who has faded late in past seasons, this is worth sending. The chart is missing this week, so this call rests on the sheet and your gut. You still keep three RBs in the top 36, so you are not giving up your last reliable back. The risk is that RBs are scarce in this format, and Watson's hot game will make him look pricier than he is. The upside is that Swift's own splits show him cooling in the second half, while Watson's role is growing. Lean in and send it, since The Blue Tent likely says yes and your starting group gets stronger.

sides.reason: You get a top WR who is drawing more of the targets as the season goes on.
